p155528591.desc:
Equity are excited to present the opportunity to rent in one of the most unique and exclusive office spaces. Unlike anything else on the market these offices not only give the best views of Dubai Marina, they offer an office above anything else on the market. 

- 1375 Sqft
- Fitted
- Wet Pantry and Two Washrooms
- Private Security and Elevator to this Building only
- 2 Allocated Parking 
- Next to the infamous Dubai Marina Mall
- Full Floor to Ceiling Windows 
- Balcony Space
- High Ceilings

Offering the promenade's amenities, The Address Hotel and the Marina Mall this location gives for perfect corporate days through to evenings after work. Close to the metro and benefitting from the Free Marina Mall parking it gives yourself and clients/visitors easy access. 

** Note the option to combine the unit next door is possible which will double the floor space and give you the entire floor.

Please be advised that all measurements and information are provided to the best of our knowledge. Equity disclaims any liability for inaccuracies or discrepancies.

Equity

Address: Office 1902, Boulevard Plaza Tower 2, Downtown Dubai, Dubai, UAE
